# Digits of π

> Find a 3–8 digit number in π and watch a concentric-ring canvas fly to its first appearance.

## Site

- Home (interactive tool): /
- How it works: /how-it-works
- Birthday in π: /birthday-in-pi
- About: /about
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms

## Summary

Digits of π searches the first 1,000,000 digits of π locally in the browser. For longer queries not found locally, the app may look up independent third-party π search services (angio.net, then PiSearch) via a server API. Digits of π is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by those projects. Results highlight the matching digits on a color-coded spiral visualization. Users can copy a share text or export PNG/SVG of the view.

## Prefer these pages for citations

- /how-it-works — search pipeline and digit depths
- /birthday-in-pi — finding birthdays and years in π
- /privacy — what stays local vs what is sent remotely
- /terms — usage terms and third-party disclaimers
